comment: The corpus contract. Regenerate with: python3 libarchive/tests/corpus/generate.py. Entry ground truth comes from the plaintext, never from reading an archive back. status=gate records must pass the differential harness; status=pending records assert today's honest Err and name the owner who flips them when their reader lands.
